about: One entry per route registered in freepbx/var/www/html/freepbx/rest/modules, keyed METHOD /pattern exactly as registered. freepbx/tests/authz_routes_test.php fails on a route with no entry and on an entry with no route.

intent is what the route SHOULD require, decided from what the endpoint does and from which screen of the new UI calls it (freepbx/nethvoice-ui/src). It is never copied from NETHVOICE_ROUTE_RULES or NETHVOICE_PREFIX_RULES in rest/lib/Permissions.php: a disagreement with the code is the finding.
Values: public (no credentials, only the authenticator), superadmin, lookup (any administrator with at least one section), one section, or a list of sections (any one is enough).

Rules of thumb: anything that returns secrets, runs commands, changes global PBX state, or is used only by the previous wizard or by no client is superadmin; reads needed by several sections are lookup. The previous wizard always signs in as a superadmin.
callers records who calls the route: ui:<area> for the new UI, legacy for the previous wizard, mcp, nethcti-server, none.
known_finding marks a reviewed disagreement between intent and code: the test prints it and does not fail. When the code is fixed the test fails until known_finding is removed.
Request-level checks for limited administrators (rejected parameters, removed secrets) and the Tancredi section checks are asserted in scenarios.json.
